title: NeuralParker: A Reinforcement Learning Planner for Irregular Parking Environments
abstract: arXiv:2608.24485v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated parking commonly assumes marked slots and short approach maneuvers. Delivery and service vehicles, however, may need to reach an operator-specified pose in an irregular bounded environment from a distant start. Existing learning-based parking planners often rely on local observations, which can restrict long-range route reasoning. To address this problem, we present NeuralParker, a reinforcement learning-based hybrid planner for arbitrary-pose parking. NeuralParker encodes full-environment obstacle and boundary geometry in a target-relative vertex representation, allowing the policy to retain route-defining context throughout the approach. It further couples a learned curvature--length arc policy with an in-loop terminal ensemble that selects from diverse cubic Hermite connections using a curvature-regularized cost. We also establish factorial and long-range route-choice benchmarks to evaluate planning success and trajectory

translated_title: NeuralParker：一种用于不规则停车环境的强化学习规划器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24485v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：自动泊车通常假设有标记的停车位和短距离的接近操作。然而，配送和服务车辆可能需要在不规则的有界环境中从较远的起点到达操作员指定的位姿。现有的基于学习的停车规划器通常依赖局部观测，这可能限制远程路径推理。为解决此问题，我们提出了NeuralParker，一种基于强化学习的混合规划器，用于任意位姿停车。NeuralParker将全环境障碍物和边界几何编码为目标相对顶点表示，使策略能够在接近过程中保留路径定义上下文。它进一步将学习到的曲率-长度弧策略与循环内终端集成相结合，该集成使用曲率正则化成本从多样化的三次Hermite连接中选择。我们还建立了因子和远程路径选择基准，以评估规划成功率和轨迹。
tldr: NeuralParker通过强化学习混合规划器，结合全环境几何编码和曲率正则化终端选择，解决了不规则环境中任意位姿停车和远程路径推理的难题。
en_tdlr: NeuralParker, a reinforcement learning-based hybrid planner, addresses irregular arbitrary-pose parking and long-range route reasoning by integrating full-environment geometry encoding with curvature-regularized terminal selection.
